name: Garlic Butter Pasta
directions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat and sauté minced garlic for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Add the pasta and a splash of pasta water, tossing to coat. Season with salt and toss in the parsley and parmesan. Serve immediately with extra parmesan.
